_README: The connectors GTM OS runs on, declared so the plugin's Connectors tab in claude.ai and Cowork lists each one with its Added / Connected state, and Claude Code connects to them directly. Every entry is the vendor's own OAuth server: the plugin carries no key and no secret, and each user signs in with their own account. Adding this plugin does not sign anyone in; environment-setup still probes every connector and places it on the S0 to S4 ladder before anything runs. Apollo, Apify and Firecrawl are required for a full run; Airtable is required for the posts base; HubSpot is optional (reverse ICP read, or the CRM when CRM_PROVIDER is hubspot). Brand Kit OS is optional and ships as its own plugin, so it is not duplicated here. tests/test_plugin_connectors.py checks this file against the vendor-URL rules in references/mcp-coverage-map.md.
